items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'Earle, I'd ask you to meet her.' I said, 'No,' I said, ''cause I know she's got a cat man will kill a rock about her,' you know.

ctx.x: Later on Earl Warren, you know, the saxophone player, his father later took it over after I left home. And Earl was just starting to play at that time, just starting to learn to play saxophone.
